story.headline: Why we started this
story.body: In 2019 a friend at OpenAI got me into an early API program, a year before ChatGPT existed. I've built with AI every day since. Friends started asking me to set up their systems. They got 10+ hours a week back, and they all said the same thing: you should teach this. So we did.

platform.headline: AI changes daily. Keeping up is a job.
platform.body: New models, new tools, a dozen papers before lunch. It's hard to follow even for us, and following it is our work. So we built the place where you don't have to do it alone.

paragraphs: In 2019 a friend at OpenAI got me into an early API program. ChatGPT didn't exist yet. The models were strange and expensive, and I built with them every day anyway, because it was obvious something had changed.

A few years in, friends started asking me to set up their systems. Not to explain AI. To make it do their work. I'd sit with them for an afternoon, and they'd get ten or more hours a week back. Every one of them said the same thing afterward: you should teach this.
One of them did more than say it. Twenty years in emerging tech, a system I had set up, and the decision to turn a favor into a company. That is the co-founder.
So we teach what we use. We measure in hours and output. We tell you when we don't know. Everything here is an experiment, and that is what the asterisk means.

footnote.headline: About the asterisk
footnote.body: Everything on this site carries a footnote, because everything here is an experiment. Models change, tools get replaced, and what worked in March may not work in June. The asterisk is a promise: we'll say what changed, and we'll say when we were wrong.
